messages.text: I agree with your draft. Maintenance gives us prepared Beacon three, so this commercial voyage does not depend on the army keeping a protection promise. I will request Guard for the communities, but I want Vigil actually offered and the Ascendant's final order written before counting that benefit. We must also avoid a Warrant consuming the same garrison.

reason: This proposal protects our people while completing an existing obligation. It leaves the council no grounds to assume either Guild vessel is available. Readiness declining concerns me, but an unfunded Campaign or speculative Raid is not a sound substitute for an agreed plan. If new information identifies a concrete danger, I will reconsider the draft before signing; this agreement is not yet a commitment.
